label: Delimiter step (strongest for short sequences)
explanation: Reset-gate unit that fires mainly at the <DEL> step (t == L), which holds about 91% of activation mass and every top activation. It fires on only about 49% of delimiter steps: nearly always for L=3-4 (with the largest magnitudes), about 64% for L=5, 26-44% for L=6-9, and the magnitude drops as L grows. Which longer sequences fire depends on content that I did not capture (e.g. first token o/c/2/k gives slight lift). A weak secondary mode (about 9% of mass) appears at original-phase steps t=1-2 on first occurrences of certain tokens (b, y, d, a, 0, p, m, i). Never fires at t=0, at original positions >= 3, or anywhere in the copy phase (t > L).
